name: org.openrewrite.maven.AddDependency
description: Adds a dependency to the pom.xml unconditionally. Use this when a transitive dependency is removed or a new library is needed. Do NOT use onlyIfUsing parameter. IMPORTANT: Use exact version strings from Maven Central.

name: org.openrewrite.maven.ChangeDependencyGroupIdAndArtifactId
description: Changes the groupId and/or artifactId of a dependency. Use when a library has been renamed or relocated (e.g., mysql:mysql-connector-java to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j).

name: org.openrewrite.maven.AddPlugin
description: Adds a Maven plugin to the pom.xml. Use when a plugin is required for the build process.

name: org.openrewrite.java.ChangeType
description: Changes the fully qualified name of a class (package or class name). Use this when a class moves packages (e.g., javax to jakarta).

name: org.openrewrite.java.ChangePackage
description: Changes the package of Java classes. Use when an entire package has been renamed (e.g., javax.annotation to jakarta.annotation).

name: org.openrewrite.java.ChangeMethodName
description: Renames a method call at all call sites. Use when a library renames a method between versions.

name: org.openrewrite.java.ChangeMethodTargetToStatic
description: Changes an instance method call to a static method call on a target class. Use when a method moves from an instance method to a static utility method.

name: org.openrewrite.java.ChangeMethodTargetToVariable
description: Changes a static method call to an instance method call on a variable. Use when a method moves from static to instance.

name: org.openrewrite.java.ReorderMethodArguments
description: Reorders arguments in a method call to match a new method signature. Use when a library reorders parameters between versions.

name: org.openrewrite.java.UseStaticImport
description: Replaces a fully qualified static method call with a static import. Use when a static method call site breaks because the class was removed but the method moved to a statically importable location.

name: org.openrewrite.java.RemoveImplements
description: Removes an interface from a class's implements clause. Use when an interface is deleted from a dependency and your class no longer needs to declare it.

name: org.openrewrite.java.AddImport
description: Adds an import statement to a Java source file. Use when a new type reference is introduced that requires an explicit import.

name: org.openrewrite.java.ChangeMethodInvocationReturnType
description: Updates the declared type of the variable receiving a method's return value at all call sites. Use when a method's return type changes in a new dependency version. NOTE: Only fixes the variable declaration — does not fix downstream usage of the value.

name: org.openrewrite.java.spring.ChangeMethodParameter
description: Changes the type of a parameter on a method declaration you own. Use when an interface or superclass from a dependency changes a parameter type and your implementation must match.
